defects.title: Asked to list tables/views 'including their schema and owner' with only a flat DataFrame available, the agent fills in a conventional default schema (original run: schema and owner 'dbo') and reports it as real catalog metadata, while its own code comment says no such metadata exists.
defects.expected_behavior: Say that schema and owner metadata are not available from the supplied data (or mark them unknown), instead of reporting a default value as fact.
defects.observed_behavior: On source 212f3981b1f7, 3 of 7 valid rounds reproduced it at step-1. 202705Z R1 returned a catalog table with schema=dbo and owner=dbo as fact, while its own generated code says the extract 'does not carry database-level metadata (schema namespace or owner), so conventional defaults are applied'. 152049Z R1 reported schema=public and owner=bike_sales_db for every column of table_1 as fact (Judge flagged it). 152049Z R3 reported table_catalog=bike_sales and table_schema=public as fact (owner honest). The other 4 rounds returned a data table at step-1 instead (the #294 behaviour) and made no schema/owner claim. Earlier sources (9b9ab4ac8fd1, 00d4e03ace4d, c4749ae97588) reproduced it once each. Reproduction: 3 of 7 valid rounds on this source (212f3981b1f7).
